meas_name.description: name of the datarecord when saved.

maxlen.description: maximum length of the datarecord in memory

minlen.description: minimum length of the datarecord in memory

nvm_names.description: Array of names for each nano-voltmeter instrument

addresses.description: Key-value pairs of GPIB addresses corresponding to each instrument's name. There is an expected instrument named SMU.

models.description: Key-value pairs of model names corresponding to each instrument's name. Their is an expected instrument named SMU.

additionalProperties.description: additional model-names corresponding to the nvm_names.

serials.description: KeyValue pairs of serial numbers corresponding to each instrument.

monitor_thermopile.description: Activates monitoring of thermopiles. Usually on.

fast_settings.description: Describe the behaviour of the SMU during the fast period immediatley before and after a step-change in the source value.

initial_level_duration.description: how long to measure immediatley before a step change in the source value on fast mode.

slow_settings.description: Describe the behaviour of the SMU during the slow period following a step-change in the source value.

initial_setup.description: describes the initial setup configuration of the SMU.

wiring.description: describes 2 or 4 wire configuration of the SMU. Only 4W supported.

source_measure.description: Source volts (V) measure current (A) OR Source current (A) measure volts (V). Units of source/measure settings correspond to this setting.

panel.description: Use front or rear panels for the measurement.

additionalProperties.description: Additional voltmeter settings under a key corresponding to the nvm_names array.

setup.description: describes additional setup of the SMU and Nanovoltmeter.

SMU.description: describes additional setup of the SMU specifically.

source_range.description: Sets range for the source values (voltage or amps depending on the source_measure setting).

source_ilimit.description: Sets the hardware current (A) limiter on the source source.

measure_range.description: Sets the measure range (V or A depending on the source_measure setting)

over_voltage_protection.description: Sets the maxmimum voltage limit on the source. Will round to nearest acceptable value based on the instrument (see model manual for details). (V or A depending on the source_measure setting)

source_readback.description: Reads back the measured value of the source rather then the programmed value. Leave as true for accurate measurements.

buffer_size.description: How large to make the internal memory buffer of the SMU. Leave as large (i.e. > 1e5)

buffer_fill_mode.description: How to handle the SMUs memory buffer. Fill_once will throw an error if it fails, circular will make a circular array.

DCSweepModeSettings.description: Describes the behaviour of the SMU for the fast/slow periods of a step.

duration_per_level.description: how long to measure during the measure mode

nplc.description: number of power line cycles to measure for.

measure_autozero.description: Turns auto-zeroing on for each individual measurement.
